ev_status_realistic.interpretation: At 20U notional the $0.0153 fixed_cost dominates the fee_proxy across every hold window; the realistic IL/LVR component widens the gap as hold increases. There is no realistic-scenario hold window that turns positive at 20U on this pool.

near_break_even_status.100u_24h_zero_il_lvr: +0.038445  (the ONLY positive cell in this pool/notional slice, only because IL/LVR is zeroed)
near_break_even_status.interpretation: 20U at 24h with zero IL/LVR drifts toward break-even (-$0.0045). 100U at 24h with zero IL/LVR goes positive (+$0.038), but that scenario is not realistic — it asserts no impermanent loss for a 24h WBNB/USDT 0.01% LP, which the realistic scenario contradicts.

pool_fee_velocity_observed.interpretation: Pool is healthy: ~$27M/24h volume, ~1700 distinct traders/24h, ~$2.7K pool-level fees/24h. A 20U LP would expect (20/POOL_TVL_PROXY) × fee_velocity × hold of this — extremely small absolute fee, but the read-only signal is solid.

capacity.interpretation: Capacity not a concern; the pool transacts $27M/24h. A 20U position is trivially small relative to the active-tick liquidity. The risk is not capacity, it's that the position will earn essentially zero in 15m due to its tiny share of the active range.

expected_fee_proxy_usd.interpretation: Pool-level fee proxy assumes (notional / $5M TVL_proxy) × pool_fee_per_sec × hold_sec. Real numbers will differ because actual position fee depends on tick-range concentration. For a $20 LP in the active range, expected actual fee at 15m is in the $0.0001-$0.001 range.

expected_il_lvr_proxy_usd.interpretation: Realistic IL/LVR = 20 bps × notional × (hold/24h). For 20U/15m that's ~$0.0004 — small. The reason the probe is still net-negative is the $0.015 fixed cost, not IL/LVR.

main_downside_risks.description: Total fixed cost (~$0.0153) is 100x the expected 15m fee proxy. Even if real fee is 10x higher than the proxy, EV stays negative.
main_downside_risks.mitigation: This probe is NOT an EV bet — it's a channel/tokenId/actual-fee validation. Accept the small loss as a research cost.

main_downside_risks.description: Only publicnode (1/5) supports bounded eth_getLogs reliably. If publicnode fails during probe, exit logic may stall.
main_downside_risks.mitigation: Probe execution (future stage) MUST set BSC_RPC_PRIMARY to a paid endpoint before going live. Dry-run can use publicnode.

main_downside_risks.description: All EV numbers use pool-level proxy. Actual position fee accrual depends on tickLower/tickUpper choice, which is not yet validated against real position behavior.
main_downside_risks.mitigation: Probe's purpose is exactly to collect this data point. Dry-run builder must emit tickLower/tickUpper choice for human review before any tx is built.

main_downside_risks.description: If we mint with token0+token1 mix and exit when range moves, we need a swap to convert back to a single token. Swap quote drift could exceed fee earnings.
main_downside_risks.mitigation: Risk-limit design (Phase D) must include swap_back_quote_drift_max stop condition.

main_downside_risks.description: Position manager / pool approvals persist across runs and create attack surface. Probe needs ApproveExact policy + post-exit revoke.
main_downside_risks.mitigation: Telemetry spec (Phase E) requires approval tx + revoke tx. Dry-run builder spec (Phase F) requires ApproveExact only.

main_downside_risks.description: BSC reorgs are rare but possible. A failed mint tx still costs gas; a confirmed mint then unconfirmed exit is the worst case.

probe_purpose_clarified: The probe is NOT a +EV trade. Its purpose is to (1) validate the LP open/close channel end-to-end, (2) retrieve a real NFT position tokenId, (3) measure actual position fee accrual via feeGrowthInside / tokensOwed, (4) calibrate the EV model against real numbers so the next iteration can reason about 100/500/1000/2000U sizing with confidence.
